dial.description: Dial string in one of the forms: unix!SOCKET, tcp!HOST[!PORT], virtio!CHANNEL, or - for stdin/stdout

mount_opts.description: Mount mode flags (mutually exclusive); only one of each may be enabled per mount request

mountpoint.description: Local mount point directory (must exist and be writable)

msize.description: Maximum length of a 9P message in bytes (must be ≤ 8192 for non-root)

spec.description: File tree spec to mount (e.g., /home/user/data); used with servers exporting multiple trees
